entries.3f103123ba5a1597: Founded in August 2005 with the aspiration to solve the malnutrition problem in Bangladesh, the company has developed its business under the purpose of 'making people and the earth healthy'. In 2020, the year of its 15th anniversary, the company set out 'Sustainability First' as the group's aspirational vision, and as its basic strategy, the 'Biomass 5F', which extends Euglena to the fields of Food, Fine Chemical, Feed, Fertilizer and Fuel in descending order of unit weight price; according to the accumulation of research, development and culture technology, it is commercializing applications in order from those with higher added value. From fiscal 2024, following the renewal of its executive structure, it is promoting its business with three key issues: 'Return to Origins', 'Biomass 5F and Ambidextrous Management' and 'Transition to a Profitable Structure'.

entries.6a62c394391433e0: A business that plans, manufactures and sells health foods and cosmetics using proprietary materials such as the microalgae Euglena and Chlorella, and also handles OEM supply and raw material sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥47,018 million, and sales channels consist of direct sales, wholesale through distribution channels, and OEM, raw materials and overseas. In addition to the company's brand "Karada ni Euglena" and the cosmetics brands "one" and "CONC," subsidiaries such as Q'SAI Co., Ltd., Epora Co., Ltd. and Satis Seiyaku Co., Ltd. develop and sell health foods and cosmetics.

entries.9a846fb90084e017: Built on mass-culture technology that achieved the world's first outdoor mass culture of Euglena for food use in December 2005, it has the technology to select among autotrophic, heterotrophic and photoheterotrophic culture methods. It is described as a feature that Euglena for food use contains 59 kinds of nutrients, has high digestibility of its nutritional components because it has no cell wall, and contains the rare component paramylon. Cultivation and production are carried out at its own group base on Ishigaki Island.

entries.bc2a642a2216fa8e: Revenue from external customers of the reportable segments was ¥47,018 million for the Healthcare Business, ¥1,092 million for the Biofuel Business and ¥2,259 million for Other Business, with the Healthcare Business accounting for most of revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,259 million. The main companies are Daikyo Hiryo Co., Ltd., which manufactures and wholesales fertilizer, GeneQuest Co., Ltd., which provides genetic analysis services, and Grameen euglena, which conducts social business in the People's Republic of Bangladesh.
entries.e21ad52984c75117: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 rose 5.8% year on year to ¥50,370 million, a record high. The MD&A explains that the contributors were strong performance in direct sales in the Healthcare Business, the full-year contribution of the results of the Satis Pharmaceutical Group, which became a consolidated subsidiary in the previous fiscal year, expansion of orders, and the steady performance of the Kyusai Group.

entries.e990e646c2cfefe2: A business that researches, develops, manufactures and sells biofuels (the biojet fuel SAF and the next-generation biodiesel fuel HVO) using biomass resources such as microalgae and industrial waste oil. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,092 million. The demonstration plant in Yokohama ended operation at the end of January 2024, and the business is now in transition to the commercialization phase. Through Pengerang Biorefinery Sdn. Bhd., a joint venture with PETRONAS and Enilive, it is advancing a project to build and operate a commercial-scale plant in Malaysia, with operations scheduled to start in the second half of 2028.
